faqs.q: How can I check the price?
faqs.a: Open the Store and choose the product. Prices can be managed by the owner from the private admin panel.

faqs.q: Can I order products through WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes. Add the verified business WhatsApp number in Admin → Brand & Contact Settings.

faqs.q: Can the owner add unlimited products?
faqs.a: Yes. Products can be added, priced, photographed and marked in/out of stock from the private admin panel.
